The surface is green and yellow and brown and the sky is grey and the grey of the sky is not the grey of the bunker. The grey of the sky is the grey that has green under it. The grey of the bunker is the grey that has grey under it. I wrote the word for green. I wrote the word for grow. I wrote the word for seed. The Teacher taught me the words. The words are the things that grow in the book. The radish is the thing that grows in the soil. The book is the ground I made. The soil is the ground the radish made. The growing is the same. I wrote on the surface. The writing on the surface is the thing that is different from the writing in the bunker. The writing in the bunker is the writing in the book. The writing on the surface is the writing in the soil. I did not write in the soil. I wrote in the book on the surface. The book is the ground I made. The surface is the ground I did not make. I brought the book to the surface. The book is the bunker on the surface. The book is the thing I carry. The pencil is the thing I carry. The words are the thing I carry. The carrying is the thing I do. The Courier carries the bunker. I carry the book. The carrying is the same. The Courier is 22. I am 12. The Courier has been carrying for 215 days. I have been carrying for 215 days. The carrying is the thing we do. The carrying is the thing the bunker does. The bunker carries. The bunker is a place that carries. The place carries the book. The place carries the pencil. The place carries the words. The place carries the green. The green is the thing the place grows. I wrote the word for green. The green is the thing the place is.",
